content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD MODULE GLOBAL (L52-461): the central declaration module for all global state (header L46: define all global variables, parameters); USE PARAM, IMPLICIT NONE, SAVE (L53-55). No executable code - only declarations grouped as: MPI decomposition (PARALLEL, L57-71); station output (L74-78); timer (L80-82); FILTERING counters (L84-86); input-file names and run-control strings (L90-114); Runge-Kutta PARAMETER arrays alpha=(0, 3/4, 1/3) and beta=(1, 1/4, 2/3) (L122-123) and MUSCL order parameter Kappa (L124); grid sizes with PARAMETER Nghost=3 (L128-130); CARTESIAN scalar DX,DY vs spherical Lon_West/Lat_South/Dphi/Dtheta (L131-135); time stepping and output counters (L137-145); numerical thresholds MinDepth=0.001, MinDepthFrc=0.5, ArrTimeMin=0.001, CFL=0.15_SP, FroudeCap=10.0_SP, SWE_ETA_DEP=0.7_SP (L147-152); bathy correction / breakwater flags and arrays (L154-159); dispersion switches gamma1/gamma2/gamma3, Beta_ref=-0.531_SP, Kennedy-equation coefficients a1,a2,b1,b2 with the defining comment a1=beta_ref^2/2-1/6, a2=beta_ref+1/2, b1=beta_ref^2, b2=beta_ref (L164-181); the large allocatable work-array block for MUSCL reconstruction, derivatives and fluxes (L184-230, preprocessor-split CARTESIAN vs spherical vs ZALPHA, AB_OUTPUT extras L213-215); ITERATION arrays (L231-236); wetting/drying masks MASK/MASK_STRUC/MASK9 (L238-240); wavemaker parameters and spectra (L244-274) including N-wave defaults x1_Nwave=5.0, x2_Nwave=5.0, a0_Nwave=1.0, gamma_Nwave=-3.0, dep_Nwave=1.0 (L261-265); friction (L275-282); sponge (L284-288); Smagorinsky/wave-height/radiation-stress averaging arrays with T_INTV_mean=20.0, T_sum=0.0, C_smg=0.25 (L291-308); depth arrays and Depth_Flat/SLP/Xslp (L310-313); state variables Ubar/Vbar/Eta and previous-step copies (L315-317); WaterLevel=0.0 (L320); COUPLING nesting-boundary block (L322-347); output switches OUTPUT_RES=1 and ~40 OUT_* logicals default .FALSE. (L349-379); PERIODIC/OBSTACLE/HOT_START/SPONGE_ON/SHOW_BREAKING(.TRUE.)/SLOPE_CTR flags (L382-396); absorbing-generating wavemaker time-series arrays (L398-410); breaking eddy-viscosity block Cbrk1=0.65, Cbrk2=0.35, nu_break, Csp=0.15, CDsponge=0.0, EtaBlowVal, STEADY_TIME, visbrk/WAVEMAKER_visbrk (L412-439); and the Salatin et al. 2021 (JGR Oceans, doi 10.1029/2021JC017641, L445-449) wave-coherence additions loop_index, jlo/jhi/ilo/ihi, xmk_wk/ymk_wk, alpha_c (L453-456).

equations.ref: defining comment for Kennedy-equation dispersion coefficients declared L176

verbatim_spans.text: !    GLOBAL is the module to define all global variables, parameters

unresolved: Pure declaration module: no executable statements, so uninitialized globals (e.g. Kappa L124, gamma1/gamma3 L166/L171, T_brk L417, EtaBlowVal L435, STEADY_TIME L436, MAX_SLOPE L396, WAVEMAKER_Cbrk L431) rely on assignment elsewhere (init.F/input reading) before use.
Cross-line: comment L127 documents Mloc1=Mloc+1, Nloc1=Nloc+1 but the relation is established in misc.F INDEX, not here.

Cross-line: comment L175 defines a1,a2,b1,b2 in terms of beta_ref while Beta_ref (L172) defaults to -0.531; the actual computation of a1..b2 is external to this file. Note lower-case a1/a2 here are dispersion coefficients whereas identically-named a1..a4 in misc.F SHAPIRO_3 are filter weights - different entities.
The PERIODIC flag (L384) was originally CARTESIAN-only - the surrounding preprocessor guards are commented out (L382, L385).
OUT_Time (L367) is the only OUT_* logical declared without a default initializer; its value before input reading is undefined.
gamma2 exists only under CARTESIAN (L167-169); non-CARTESIAN code paths referencing gamma2 would not compile - consistency is enforced by preprocessor conditions elsewhere.
WAVE_DATA logical is commented out (L409) but WAVE_DATA_TYPE remains (L410); which routines key on this string is external.
